tile.$description: Mosaic tile margin — Square's historical value; adjacent tiles show a 2px seam filled by the divider.

section.$description: Between stacked sections within a region.

window.$description: Padding between the window edge and the app shell — >0 makes the whole UI float on bg-canvas.

width.$description: Mosaic split bar width (also the drag hit-area). Square's historical value. Keep = 2 × gap.tile so the bar fills the seam.

color.$description: Split bar fill. Gap presets set this transparent so floating tiles have invisible-but-draggable seams (hover still shows accent).

surface.$description: Multi-layer shadow ring around panes/cards. Square uses real 1px borders instead.

scale.$description: Multiplier on control heights/padding. Square is compact = 1.
